infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Nexus needs access to contacts so the agent can resolve names you mention into phone numbers and email addresses.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nexus uses the microphone to transcribe your voice commands locally before sending to your configured speech-to-text provider.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Nexus uses your location only when you ask the agent for location-aware tasks (e.g. travel time to an event).

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Nexus to access your contacts so the agent can resolve names to phone numbers.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Nexus to use your location for location-aware agent tasks.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Nexus to access the microphone for voice input.
